svg.title: A Meteogram of a complete convective cycle
svg.desc: A Meteogram for one site and one day: pressure, precipitation, cloud, thermal velocity, and CAPE strips above a time-height wind field where the boundary layer, usable lift, and cloud base rise and fall beneath light veering wind.

svg.aria-label: Meteogram for Synthetic Ridge, model convective-cycle, 2000-01-01 10a to 7p (Etc/UTC): surface metric strips above a time-height field; derived series, isotherms, shading overlays and winds aloft are drawn over the profile.
